title: Extract a load-bearing bracket pin without dropping the carriage
instruction: Extract the retaining pin completely from both brackets while keeping the orange carriage at its marked starting height. Keep control of the pin.
context: Removing a fastener can release a supported load. This bench-scale task tests maintaining that load while extracting its retaining pin.
setup: Two YAM arms at the calibrated station; wooden tabletop z=0.7475 m, x forward and y left. A fixed nominal steel stand has origin (0.350,-0.020,0.920) m. Its base is 200x220x16 mm, centred locally at (0,-35,-164.5) mm. Two bracket plates at local y=-40 and +40 mm each have a 14x14 mm square bore: two 18x12x44 mm side walls centred at x=+/-16 mm and two 14x12x15 mm cross walls at z=+/-14.5 mm. Each plate connects through two 65x12x16 mm struts centred at x=+/-57.5 mm to two 18x12x134.5 mm legs at x=+/-90 mm,z=-89.25 mm. Frame is fixed (1 kg nominal numerical mass). An orange painted steel carriage, 0.8 kg, starts at the same origin, with another identical four-wall bore at local y=0. Its support handle comprises a 50x12x28 mm stem at (0,0,-36) mm, a 50x110x12 mm arm at (0,-50,-50) mm and a 26x50x40 mm grip at (0,-100,-40) mm. A passive vertical guide permits -60 to +12 mm travel. A free 90 g steel pin has a 12 mm diameter,155 mm shaft extending from local y=-175 to -20 mm and a blue 26x36x30 mm grasp head at its origin; head starts at world (0.350,0.100,0.920) m. A fixed green 80x80x2 mm marker is centred at (0.350,0.300,0.7485) m. Left TCP starts at (0.350,0.100,0.924) m pointing downward around the pin head; right arm starts in the station ready pose. Initial joint poses, masses, inertia and all solids are supplied in pilot.json and geometry.json. Gravity settles the carriage about 2 mm before recording.
scoring: Any carriage-height error greater than 10 mm from nominal z=0.920 m, downward carriage speed over 0.35 m/s, pin-origin height below 0.7725 m, or moving origin outside -0.19<x<0.91 m, |y|<0.65 m and 0.7425<z<1.4 m permanently gives zero. Invalid states are errors, never successes. Shaft clearance requires both transformed shaft endpoints including a 6 mm radius margin entirely beyond y=0.041 m or before y=-0.081 m. With no violation, clearance plus pin origin within 80 mm of either TCP earns 0.5. Full score additionally requires carriage height error below 8 mm and both pin and carriage translation speeds below 20 mm/s continuously for one second. Otherwise zero or the valid partial score while awaiting stable completion. Retention is a geometric proximity proxy.
reset_notes: Restore the fixed starting poses and zero carriage joint in the supplied JSON; reset both robots as in pilot.json, seed 0, no object jitter. Allow the built-in 0.5-second settling period. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Native Isaac Sim 6.1 / PhysX rigid-body contacts at 240 Hz and robot commands at 20 Hz. Bores are square rings made from separate solids. Nominal friction: bore/shaft 0.8 static,0.6 dynamic; carriage grip 1.0/0.8. The ideal vertical guide and its stops replace a real linear bearing; it has no drive,spring or joint friction. Fixed stand, nominal masses and rigid parts are not calibrated commercial hardware. No fracture,deformation,injury or grasp-force model. Direct pulling can extract the loaded pin; the demonstrated contrast is preventing the carriage drop, not an extraction-force threshold. Fixed layout and one seed only.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (1,200 controls); scripted demo: 1.0 (275 controls,13.75 simulated seconds).
